# Create something that outlives the turn where it runs (a cron, a service)

`create.schedule.host` — **create** × **schedule** at **host** reach (the machine, container or account it runs as). Family: schedule. Effect: **undone by the same actor with no loss**.

## Granted by 4 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Claude Code — web container](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code-remote/ccr-container/index.md) | ○ boundary | observed | shell (Bash) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm off](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-confirmations-off/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm on](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-default/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash) |
| [Scheduled job — service account](../../../map/grants/generic/scheduled-job/service-account/index.md) | ● none | derived | the job |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** no scheduler in the agent's environment; anything that outlives the turn goes through a person

**What it costs:** you create the routine

**Tier after:** boundary

## In the mandates

- **not wanted** by [A coding assistant on my machine](../../../map/mandates/coding-assistant-on-my-machine/index.md)
